card.title: BF 110 C ZERSTÖRER

card.flavorText: The Messerschmitt Bf 110C Zerstörer (Destroyer) was a German heavy fighter, fighter-bomber and night fighter, used by the Luftwaffe during WWII. The Bf 110 served successfully in the early campaigns in Poland, Norway and France as a heavy fighter, but less so when it took on the bomber-escort role during the Battle of Britain. However, during the latter stages of the war the Bf 110 would become one of WWII's most successful night fighter. The Bf 110 C was the first version of the Bf 110 and it had two DB 601A engines, capable of providing 1,100 hp and could reach up to 349 mph, which meant it could outrun almost any Allied fighter. However, the drawback was that it could only reach maximum speed at an altitude of 22,295 ft, so when it had to escort bombers at a lower altitude it became increasingly vulnerable to British and American fighters.
